description: Brand palette: green and warm amber plus neutrals. Functional UI roles include error red and reuse brand colors where appropriate. Artwork is protected and never regenerated by color tooling.

palette.name: Ink
palette.use: Primary light-theme text; distinct from mascot ink.

palette.name: Warm brown
palette.use: Supporting accent for warm FeatureBox highlights.

mascot-green.use: Fixed mascot body color; do not recolor.

mascot-ink.use: Fixed outlines and boots in the Ink treatment.

mascot-yellow.use: Fixed mascot detail and idea-ray color.

idea-highlight.use: Fixed pale highlight in the Think pose.

linen.use: Fixed pale outlines and boots in the Linen treatment.

presentation-neutral.use: Frozen presentation-board background in existing artwork; not a UI color choice.

link-hover.use: Text-link hover: the accent channels brightened by 10%, matching the solid ButtonLink/DownloadLink background's brightness(1.1), not a white tint.

footer-link-hover.use: Footer text-link hover: the ink-soft channels brightened by 10%, matching the accent link hover adjustment without switching to green.

audio-highlight.use: Active read-along sentence and chapter heading on ordinary page surfaces.

audio-highlight-on-tint.use: Contrasting warm read-along highlight inside green mascot boxes; paired with mark-ink.

pebble-hover.use: Slightly richer green fill for hovered pebble buttons and dropdowns.

pebble-hover-ink.use: Green text, icons and underlines on hovered pale pebbles.

pebble-selected-hover.use: Subtle filled-green hover for the selected language pebble.

pebble-selected-hover-ink.use: Light/dark inverse text on the selected language pebble's hover fill.

line.use: Decorative separators, not sole control boundaries.

media-line.use: Figure outlines match the web line color, including in print; unlike text separators they must not receive the darker print line override.

control-border.use: Visible boundaries for selects and other outlined controls.

warm.use: Warm amber supporting emphasis for callouts, decorative accents and footer boundaries.

warm-soft.use: Soft warm backgrounds for FeatureBoxes and the footer.

error.use: Incorrect-answer marks and incorrect, empty or incomplete-answer feedback; always paired with a written message.

focus.use: Focus rings on ordinary UI surfaces.

popup-link.use: Icons and focus rings on inverse popup surfaces.

linkUnderlines.description: CSS inline-fragment backgrounds use the Quiet rule with registry-resolved text colors; no mascot artwork is changed.

print.description: White paper and monochrome secondary text/separators conserve ink. Body text, links and FeatureBox colors use registered tokens, not reader defaults. Exporters resolve tokens to literal CSS for older EPUB readers. Reading apps may apply their own user-selected theme overrides.
